mentions.name: Tensward
mentions.description: Tensward is a local AI inference optimisation tool that detects the user's environment and helps optimise inference, running completely locally.
mentions.problem: Inference optimisation when deploying a local model in a client's environment was a huge headache involving a difficult balancing act.
mentions.source_excerpt: gave me the idea to create Tesnward - a local AI inference optimisation tool - Tensward detect your environment and help you optimise inference, it runs completely local
mentions.author: tensward
